What they fix for the map is the meaning of an extent: 'ends for good' is not returning, which is the same as being drawn into a region never left (dynamics 1 and 3), and 'goes out' means a member bears the relation to something outside (dynamic 5, the legend of the tie crosses). The fifth, every-loss-passes-a-juncture, is legend in its main laws and meets the web only at the tie reaches, through two TimedResponse laws. Where the forms were short: (1) an iff between two predicates of one course or one region (drawn exactly where not returning; not gone out of exactly where what is not outside is closed) has no amount or time, so it is not a border; it is written as a tie holding both ways. (2) Several conclusions hold only up to double negation, and two calibrations say that finding more would give LPO or excluded middle; no form or mark carries that. (3) 'Is at a configuration at some step' and 'two courses meet' have no mark; begins is the nearest. (4) Transitivity of meeting is a law of a relation between courses, and keeping is an operation on a process; neither is a role or a tie. (5) The frames have none for a law that sets 'every run from a configuration' against 'some course from it', nor for several courses of one law. Read only: nothing was run, built or written.
